description: Apply a preview plan to existing Meta objects. Takes the planId from ads_edit_preview (valid for 15 minutes) and the confirm flags named in that preview's requiredConfirmations. Returns a result per change: applied, failed, skipped or pending. Pending means not sent yet and still waiting in its review. Applying the same planId again returns the first result and changes nothing more. Archive and delete cannot be undone. Accounts in review mode return EDITS_REVIEW_REQUIRED with a reviewUrl; those changes are approved in the Agent Inbox.

allowLargeChange.description: Confirms a large budget change. Needed when the preview's requiredConfirmations lists large_change.

confirmIrreversible.description: Confirms an archive or delete, which cannot be undone. Needed when the preview's requiredConfirmations lists irreversible.

confirmLiveChange.description: Confirms a change to an object that is live. Needed when the preview's requiredConfirmations lists live_change.

confirmSpend.description: Confirms a change that starts or raises spend. Needed when the preview's requiredConfirmations lists spend.

name: ads_edit_apply
title: Apply Meta Edits
